what: Every legal column shape rendered against the live compiler, plus the full condition grammar and the market-read marker layer.

columnSweep.claim: omega.fanout.outputs_for predicted the platform headers exactly for every shape it rendered: 300 structural shapes, 536 headers, 0 mismatches, across all 16 authorable transforms. It did NOT cover every legal shape - see coverageCorrection.

quarantined.reason: declared legal by the contract, INTERNAL_ERROR when rendered

coverageCorrection._correctedTwice: I answered this with a one-liner twice and got it wrong both times, in opposite directions. First: "300 of 488, 61% covered, 188 untested" - outputs_for on an unexpanded spread emits the placeholder header X_?_spread, so all 175 spread structural shapes were counted uncovered BY CONSTRUCTION. Second: "zero spread headers ever rendered" - I read only _sweep_seen.json; six other caches hold renders and 27 spread headers sit in them. It is a script with a test now.

structural.note: excludes the 175 placeholder spread shapes, which carry no testable header until an operand is chosen

coverageCorrection.whichDenominatorMatters: The operand-expanded one. A spread's legality depends on the OPERAND as well as the base - addendum item 2 established that both sides need a stored bar series - so an untested (base, operand) pair is an untested legality claim, not a repeat of one already proven.
coverageCorrection.riskClass: Same class as the timeless-column-timeframe defect found 2026-08-26: omega calls a shape legal, the platform refuses it. That one surfaced by accident. 1,776 spread pairs have never been asked.

_resolved.result: operand-expanded 1759/1759 rendered live (100%), structural 301/301 (100%), 0 header mismatches.
_resolved.found: One undocumented legality rule, at pair 545: a spread chained into a series-building transform needs a candle-backed operand. 357 shapes. data/audit/spread_chain_operand.json.
_resolved._headerCountCorrection: An earlier draft of this block said 3,113 headers. It is 2,379 - the batch records sum to that. The 3,113 was a stale figure from the pre-fix plan, which still counted the 357 illegal shapes and their fan-out.

budgetModel.finding: columnLookback is constant, not a per-column cost and not a function of metric period.
budgetModel.evidence: 13 renders of 1, 4, 5, 8, 9, 12, 18, 24 and 30 columns, spanning every transform and including SMA200, all reported columnLookback = 24 exactly.
budgetModel.correctedHypothesis: SMA50 and SMA200 were isolated on the theory that a long metric period would exceed the 32-bar cap. Measured false - both render normally at the same lookback as a close price.

conditionGrammar.nestedGroupReferencingGroups: resolves - NESTED_GROUP referenced two groups (CONF_UP, TWO_OF_THREE), a three-level DAG

provisionalFlag.note: Exactly as documented: the live forming bar propagates from column to condition. The one condition reading an ambient header (usdtUsdDev_market) came back provisional:false; all 12 reading custom columns came back true.

conditionGrammar.conditionsAreAdvisory: Platform wording, verbatim: 'they may make you more selective, never less - they do not gate, score, or qualify anything.' The exception is required:true, enforced upstream.

zoneVocabularyDefect.severity: silent - an authored condition is permanently FALSE with no error
zoneVocabularyDefect.what: All five classifyZone columns declare conditionVocabulary [overbought, oversold, neutral]. Two of them never emit any of those values.
zoneVocabularyDefect.consequence: An `is` or `in` condition on ADX_zone or MFI14_zone, written from the vocabulary the platform itself publishes, can never evaluate TRUE. It returns FALSE, not UNRESOLVED, so nothing signals that the author used an impossible label.

legalityModelConfirmed.platform: VALIDATION_ERROR REPORT_COLUMN_PAIR_UNSUPPORTED - 'not a composable pair - the engine has no resolution home for it'
legalityModelConfirmed.note: The platform's error also names the allowed set for that metric: value, trajectory, spread, efficiency, maxShare, rank.

conditionsWrite.note: The earlier write exercised the REPORT axis only. This one closes MARKET_READ and CONDITIONS, so all three axes an authored strategy touches have now been written and read back. The server rewrote every sectionKey: null to the real custom:<uuid> on the way in, and resolved the ambient clause to sectionKey 'reference-pairs'.
